description: Angular component for a widget button custom style panel, allowing users to customize button styles such as colors and shadows, with reactive form handling and preview updates.

classes.name: WidgetButtonCustomStylePanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for customizing widget button styles, including color overrides and shadow options, with live preview and form validation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form controls, subscriptions, and copies initial style.

methods.name: copyStyle
methods.description: Copies style from a specified button state into the form for editing.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: applyCustomStyle
methods.description: Emits the custom style from the form to be applied.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets form values based on the provided custom style, with default fallbacks.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on override checkboxes.

methods.name: updatePreviewAppearance
methods.description: Updates the preview appearance based on current form values.
